question: What eightfold division is sought to be known in full detail?
premises: A division into groups of eight is mentioned.
The speaker seeks to know this division fully.
The knowledge is desired in full detail.
inference: The speaker seeks to know fully and in detail the division into groups of eight.
uncertainties: anantathā may mean endlessly or in infinite detail
plain_english: I wish to know fully and in detail the division into the groups of eight.
